checks.check: A written decision for each of the three questions, with spike evidence and the fallback taken or rejected

floatStage.decision: RGBA32F intermediates, straight color, one round-half-up quantization on exit, no dither by default
floatStage.parityRgba32f: worst 1 code value on 32 of 703,104 channels; float difference <= 2.7e-6
floatStage.parityRgba16f: worst 1 code value on up to 26,176 channels per still; float difference <= 1.6e-3 (rejected)
floatStage.recovery: gain 2 then 0.5: RGBA8 127 codes lost; RGBA16F and RGBA32F 0
floatStage.banding: 11 neutral-sum passes on a 256 ramp: RGBA8 57 levels (max error 12); RGBA32F 256 levels (0)
floatStage.unormRounding: GPU float->RGBA8 equals round-half-up on 256/256 tie samples
floatStage.memory: RGBA32F 31.6 MiB at 1080p, 126.6 MiB at 4K per surface; pixel budget 7.375 GiB (1 worker) to 1.75 GiB (4 workers)
